visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man walks down a brightly lit luxury apartment hallway with neutral-toned walls and recessed ceiling lights. He wears a beige short-sleeved knit shirt with a horizontal texture and a thick silver chain necklace. He appears visibly annoyed, squinting and rubbing his nose as he moves toward the camera. (2) A cinematic close-up transitions into a darkened room where a spherical white ceramic reed diffuser is dramatically lit from above. The diffuser features an engraved horse-head emblem, representing the Golden Horse Awards. Dark reeds protrude from the top against the shadowy background. (3) The scene shifts to a modern home interior with warm lighting. The man leans toward the white diffuser on a dark shelf, inhaling deeply with a satisfied expression. A small picture-in-picture window at the bottom right shows a clip from a previous room tour video. (4) The man sits at a dining table with the diffuser placed in front of him. He gestures with his hands while explaining the product's features. Large yellow and black variety-show style captions appear across the center of the frame. (5) Detailed shots focus on the "Klower Pandor" brand text and the "Anta Pottery" seal on the ceramic base. The lighting is soft and flattering, highlighting the smooth, matte texture of the object. (6) The man is shown in various locations within his home, placing the diffuser on a cabinet next to a large red and gold action figure, and then on a bar counter filled with glass bottles. The editing uses fast cuts to show the product's versatility. (7) Close-up views of the diffuser are overlaid with multiple green and white text boxes detailing its ingredients and official certifications. The background remains out of focus to keep the attention on the product and the informative text. (8) The final phase shows the man in a relaxed state, lounging in a gray fabric armchair near a large window with natural daylight. He holds a book and looks peaceful, with the white diffuser resting on a wooden side table next to him.

The music shifts instantly into a clean, melodic electronic track with a soft piano motif and a steady, gentle beat. The spectral brightness increases significantly here. (3) The narrator's voice transforms into a warm, friendly, and high-arousal tone. He greets the audience with "Ah, yes," and describes the "captivating scent" of the Klower Pandor diffuser. His speech rate is moderate and his articulation is very clear. (4) A sharp "ding" notification sound effect occurs as specific text about the Golden Horse Awards collaboration appears. The BGM maintains its upbeat yet sophisticated tempo, providing a high-quality production bed for the informative narration. (5) The speaker continues with a professional, narrative tone, listing technical details like the 45-year history of the pottery brand and safety certifications. The music continues to overlap with his speech at a balanced volume level until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Problem -> Solution -> Product Origin -> Features -> Benefit
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a promotional advertisement for Klower Pandor reed diffusers. It follows a narrative arc starting with the relatable frustration of a 'smelly environment' to introduce the brand as an essential part of an upscale, pleasant home lifestyle. The endorsement leverages the prestige of the Golden Horse Awards and traditional pottery craftsmanship to build brand authority.
